citation: This job, computed from AE000511.1 / NC_000915.1 (NCBI efetch)
claim_tested: An in-frame start codon exists upstream of the annotated GTG with no intervening stop
key_finding: TTG at 1580280, 14 codons upstream of the annotated GTG at 1580322. All 13 intervening codons are open; the first in-frame stop upstream is TAA at 1580229 (31 codons up). Translation of 1580280..1581479 gives exactly 399 aa.
confidence_and_limitations: High. This is the decisive test and it is a direct read of the deposited genome sequence. No assumption beyond the standard code.

claim_tested: The 399-residue product is the current reference annotation
key_finding: PGAP annotates HP_RS07460 (old_locus_tag HP1507) as 1580280..1581479, 1200 nt, initiator TTG, product saccharopine dehydrogenase family protein, EC 1.5.1.-. The translated 399-mer is byte-identical to WP_015056101.1.
confidence_and_limitations: High for the fact of the annotation. Database-level, so it is corroboration rather than independent evidence; PGAP and my own walk use related logic.

claim_tested: The longer CDS is reproduced across assemblies
key_finding: 78 genome assemblies carry this exact protein; the CDS span is 1200 nt in 78 of 78.
context: H. pylori, multiple strains including 26695 derivatives, FDAARGOS_299, Rif1, Rif2
confidence_and_limitations: High. IPG members are partly redundant 26695 re-sequencings, so this shows reproducibility of the call, not independent strain sampling.

citation: This job, 400-record sample of 6456 NCBI protein records
claim_tested: 26695 is the annotation outlier within H. pylori
key_finding: Of 382 orthologs, 375 (98.2%) are 399 aa beginning MHTVLQIGAGGVGS, 6 (1.6%) are 380 aa beginning MGMNRDVFKNII, 1 is 317 aa. Zero reproduce the 385-aa O26037 N-terminus MVAHKMGMNRD.
confidence_and_limitations: High for direction, moderate for the exact percentage. The 400-record slice is arbitrary, not a random sample of distinct strains, and entries are not independent.

citation: UniProt / InterPro: Q17ZI8, I0ESJ2, I0EKU9, D3UGV5, E7ADD4, A0A0K2YBB9, A0A6J4D0M1, A0A3D8J7L2, A0A3D8J1F2, A0AA90PPK2, A0ABM7SFN6
claim_tested: Genus-wide orthologs begin at the position equivalent to M1 of the 399-mer
key_finding: All 11 Helicobacter orthologs outside H. pylori begin M-x-x-V-L-Q-I-G-A-G-G-V-G-x, carrying the Rossmann GxGxxG fingerprint at positions 8-13. Only O26037 (385 aa) and H. pylori G27 B5Z9C5 (380 aa) lack it.
context: H. acinonychis, H. cetorum, H. mustelae, H. felis, H. suis, H. heilmannii, H. anseris, H. brantae, H. cappadocius, H. gastrofelis
confidence_and_limitations: High. Covers 71-97% identity, so the uniformity is not an artifact of near-identical sequences. These are annotations, not experimental N-termini.

claim_tested: The O26037 truncation removes part of the cofactor-binding domain match
key_finding: O26037 PF03435 2-120 and SSF51735 15-176 equal 16-134 and 29-190 in 399 numbering, against ortholog values 1-135 and 1-191. The N-terminal boundary is clipped by 12 residues (PF03435) and 27 (SSF51735); PF16653 agrees exactly at 141-392.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Automated and independent of my own alignment. Domain boundaries are model artifacts to a degree
column8: but the C-terminal agreement controls for that.

claim_tested: The segment absent from O26037 is structurally integral and contacts NADP
key_finding: Residues 2-14 contribute 15 heavy atoms within 4.0 A of NAP 501, from Gly8, Ala9, Gly10, Gly11, Val12. 12 of the 15 atoms are backbone; 3 are side chain (Ala9 CB, Val12 CB and CG2). Thr3-Ile7 is strand 3 of a 7-stranded sheet, parallel-paired to Ala33. Helix A runs Gly10-Asn23, so the O26037 start at equivalent position 15 falls mid-helix. Residues 2-14 make 285 heavy-atom contacts under 4.5 A with 33 core residues.
context: H. pylori NCTC11637 carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase, crystal with NADP
confidence_and_limitations: High for the coordinates. The entity is A0A2X5A3P4 (NCTC11637), 99.0% identical to the 26695 399-mer with no mismatch inside the extension, so transfer to 26695 is safe. The construct carries a GSHMAS tag, so SEQRES does not report a native N-terminus.

claim_tested: A TTG initiator and its RBS are ordinary in this genome
key_finding: TTG initiates 146 CDSs (9.54%), more than GTG (94, 6.14%); 41 TTG CDSs are 1200 nt or longer. Anti-SD duplex score at the proposed TTG is 13 (AGGTG, 4 nt spacer), the 72.4th percentile of 1528 CDSs (median 12).
confidence_and_limitations: High. Removes the objection that TTG or the RBS is implausible. The score difference against the annotated GTG (13 vs 12, 66.1th percentile) does not discriminate between the two starts.

claim_tested: Extending the CDS does not create a gene overlap
key_finding: HP1506 gltS occupies 1578968..1580194 on the minus strand, divergent from HP1507. The intergenic region is 85 bp (1580195..1580279) and the proposed TTG at 1580280 abuts its edge. The first in-frame upstream stop (1580229) lies inside the intergenic region.
confidence_and_limitations: High. Rules out the alternative that the upstream in-frame region belongs to a neighbouring CDS. Compatible with the longer CDS but does not prove it.

claim_tested: The protein is carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase, not an ATP-binding protein
key_finding: PDB 8H52 is deposited as H. pylori carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase in complex with NADP.
confidence_and_limitations: High for the identification. The legacy O26037 product name 'conserved hypothetical ATP-binding protein' is obsolete.

claim_tested: The CASDH route is the spermidine pathway in these bacteria
key_finding: Hanfrey et al. describe the alternative carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase / carboxyspermidine decarboxylase route in Campylobacter jejuni and gut microbiota.
confidence_and_limitations: High for the pathway. Not H. pylori 26695 directly.

claim_tested: H. pylori does not use canonical spermidine synthase
key_finding: Zhang and Au report that H. pylori lacks the classical spermidine synthase route.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Supports the CASDH assignment indirectly by elimination.

claim_tested: A TSS upstream of 1580280 would confirm the longer transcript
key_finding: dRNA-seq primary transcriptome of 26695 maps TSSs genome-wide. The TSS table was not retrieved in this job, so no claim is made about this locus.
confidence_and_limitations: Not evaluated. This is the most direct unexercised test and is stated as a gap, not as evidence.

claim_tested: Ribosome profiling with initiation signatures is the standard way to settle start sites
key_finding: Giess et al. re-annotate translation initiation sites in prokaryotic translatomes and provide evidence of N-terminal truncations and extensions of previously annotated coding sequences.
confidence_and_limitations: High as a methods reference. Not applied to H. pylori HP_1507.

claim_tested: No experimental N-terminus is reported for HP_1507
key_finding: No proteomic or ribosome-profiling study reporting an N-terminal peptide for HP_1507 was found. Nothing can be quoted.
confidence_and_limitations: High confidence in the absence of an easily findable report; absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
